args.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, per their own web search, can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. This needs your consent. Please tell us: (1) do you agree to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing LG and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to the LG (inspect, repair, dispose, keep); (4) or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect/repair it first? Please reply by 2025-07-29.
options: Agree to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal/fitting and what happens to the LG
Our contractor inspects the LG first
